Favicon Generator

Generate a complete PNG favicon set (16–512 px) from your logo in one click, download it as a ZIP, and copy the ready-to-paste HTML link tags.

⭐ Drop your logo here or click to browse

Preview

Generates a PNG favicon set (universally supported); .ico format not included. Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload your logo (PNG with transparency works best).
  2. Click “Generate favicons” — six PNGs are created at 16, 32, 48, 180, 192 and 512 px.
  3. Preview the set, then click “Download ZIP” to get all files.
  4. Click “Copy HTML” and paste the link tags into your page’s <head>.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why is there no .ico file?

A PNG set works in every modern browser. The classic .ico container format needs a dedicated encoder, so it is not included — PNG favicons are universally supported.

What if my logo is not square?

Your logo is scaled to fit (contain) on a transparent background, so non-square logos are never stretched or cropped.

How do I install the favicons?

Paste the snippet into the <head> of your HTML and upload the PNG files next to it (usually the site root).
